verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show configurable data retention for transcripts/audio (default 2 years, adjustable) which addresses the retention half of the story, but there is no evidence of per-call recording enable/disable controls or built-in consent/disclosure messaging features for call recording compliance. Missing for 10: per-call recording toggle or opt-out mechanism, explicit consent/disclosure banner or messaging feature, documentation tying retention settings to legal consent requirements.
